blurb: Guests visit the brewery to enjoy a variety of craft beers including hard seltzers, with no artificial flavoring. The brewery hosts live music typically on Friday or Saturday evenings and features local food trucks weekly. They sell refillable 32oz growlers and branded merchandise like hats and t-shirts.
extraNote: Tables are first come, first serve; reservations for special events by contact · Closed on Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, and Thanksgiving · Open on Labor Day, Mother and Father’s Day, Easter Sunday, and New Years Eve
